arguments.command: cd ${args.repo_dir} && timeout 500 ./gradlew :app:lintDebug --offline > /tmp/skill_lint.log 2>&1; echo "lint_exit=$?"; grep -oE '[0-9]+ errors?, [0-9]+ warnings?' app/build/reports/lint-results-debug.txt 2>/dev/null | head -1; grep -cE 'daemon disappeared|FAILURE' /tmp/skill_lint.log || echo 0

find /root/.gradle -name aapt2 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1 | while read A; do "$A" dump badging ${args.repo_dir}/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'package:|launchable' | head -2; done; true

cd ${args.repo_dir}; for DEX in $(unzip -l app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk | grep -o 'classes[0-9]*\.dex'); do H=$(unzip -p app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk $DEX | strings | grep -c "${args.dex_probe}" || true); [ "$H" != "0" ] && echo "probe '${args.dex_probe}' found in $DEX ($H hits)"; done; echo dex_probe_scan_done
